cards.title: Brain Waves Unlock Next Frontier for Physical AI
cards.body: Frontier physical AI models are moving beyond simple video to require multiple camera angles, dense annotation, and brain wave readings. This represents a significant leap in how AI systems understand and learn from human physical interaction.

cards.title: Chinese AI Moonshot Kimi Rattles Silicon Valley

cards.body: A Canadian legislator read an apparent LLM-generated response during parliamentary proceedings, raising questions about AI use in governance. The incident highlights emerging concerns about AI-generated political content.

cards.body: Opus 5 represents incremental improvements in token efficiency rather than a major capability leap forward. The release focuses on cost optimization for existing AI applications.

cards.title: Trump EPA May Reduce Neighbor Input on Data Centers
cards.body: AI firms seeking more data center expansion may benefit from reduced environmental review requirements under Trump's EPA policies. The regulatory shift prioritizes infrastructure development for AI computing.

cards.title: Robot Snakes Search Venezuelan Earthquake Survivors
cards.body: AI-powered robotic snakes were deployed to search collapsed buildings for survivors after a Venezuelan earthquake. The application demonstrates AI robotics' humanitarian potential in disaster response.
